name: menpowidgets
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "menpowidgets" %}
{% set version = "0.5.0" %}
# menpo (a dependency) is noarch with python_min 3.11 on conda-forge, so the noarch test environment is
# solved at 3.11 (upstream supports 3.10 on PyPI)
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 78f734233d4b8345411bceee476a55b63833ab8e72909ef745748da06d3c46bc

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - setuptools-scm >=8
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - menpo >=0.12.1
    - ipywidgets >=8
    - ipyevents >=2
    - anywidget >=0.9

test:
  imports:
    - menpowidgets
    - menpowidgets.base
    - menpowidgets.options
    - menpowidgets.tools
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
  commands:
    - pip check

about:
  home: https://github.com/menpo/menpowidgets
  dev_url: https://github.com/menpo/menpowidgets
  doc_url: https://menpowidgets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Menpo's Jupyter widgets for fancy visualization
  description: |
    Jupyter widgets to browse and inspect Menpo's objects (images, shapes,
    landmarks, models, 3D meshes, and with menpofit the fitting results) and
    a webcam widget. menpofit (for the fitting visualizations) and menpo3d
    plus Mayavi (for the 3D widgets) are optional.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - patricksnape
